title: Prohibiting those Convicted of Sexual Offences and Violent Crimes from Practising as Educators or Tutors
what_it_is: Prohibiting those Convicted of Sexual Offences and Violent Crimes from Practising as Educators or Tutors

sections.label: MOE hiring offenders
sections.summary: MOE does not hire anyone who has committed offences of moral turpitude, including sexual offences and violent crimes.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE does not hire anyone who has committed offences of moral turpitude, including sexual offences and violent crimes.

sections.label: Tuition centre registration rules
sections.summary: Centres with 10 or more students and their tutors must register with MOE and declare convictions, but MOE does not conduct background checks on these private employees.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Under the Education Act, centres offering tuition or enrichment programmes to 10 or more students must be registered with MOE.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Tutors working at these centres must also be registered with MOE.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: During registration, applicants must declare whether they have been convicted of any offence punishable with imprisonment, including sexual offences or violent crimes.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE will not register any applicant who declares that he or she has been convicted of such serious offences.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: However, MOE does not conduct background checks on these applicants as they are employees of private businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Freelance tutors or enrichment teachers who offer private lessons outside of centres, for example, in homes or agencies that provide matching services between private tutors and students, currently do not need to be registered with MOE and are not covered by the regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: As the Minister for Home Affairs had informed Parliament in April 2022, the Government is reviewing how best to strengthen the screening framework for those working with children.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This includes whether to make it mandatory for freelance providers of services for children to be screened for serious offences, including sexual offences.
